name: DropdownMenu
description: An account-style dropdown menu built on the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern, with icons, shortcut hints, group labels, separators, animated checkbox items and a flyout submenu. It scales in from the trigger with measured, viewport-aware placement and supports full keyboard navigation with typeahead.
a11yNotes: Follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: the trigger has aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role="menu" labelled by the trigger, with role="menuitem", role="menuitemcheckbox" (aria-checked) and role="separator" children and roving DOM focus. Enter/Space/ArrowDown on the trigger open and focus the first item, ArrowUp focuses the last. Inside: ArrowUp/ArrowDown wrap, Home/End jump, Enter/Space activate (checkbox items toggle without closing), printable keys typeahead, ArrowRight opens the submenu (aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded) and ArrowLeft/Escape close it back to its parent, Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger, Tab closes and continues the tab order. Disabled items are skipped and marked aria-disabled. Under prefers-reduced-motion the menus only fade.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Entries of type 'item' (label, value, icon, shortcut, disabled), 'checkbox' (label, defaultChecked, disabled), 'label', 'separator' and 'submenu' (label, icon, items). Icons are built-in names: user, card, settings, keyboard, users, user-plus, mail, message, plus, help, cloud, logout.

propsApi.name: onOpenChange
propsApi.description: Called whenever the menu requests to open or close.

propsApi.name: onSelect
propsApi.description: Called with the item's value (or label) when an item is chosen; the menu then closes.

propsApi.name: onCheckedChange
propsApi.description: Called when a checkbox item is toggled.

propsApi.name: side
propsApi.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room in the viewport.

propsApi.name: align
propsApi.description: Horizontal alignment relative to the trigger, clamped inside the viewport.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Highlight tint, check marks and active icon color.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
